sections.label: TOOL CALL: python
sections.content:
<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
def player_pos():
    c = current_frame.ascii.split('\n')
    rs = [i for i in range(len(c)) for j in range(len(c[i])) if c[i][j] == 'O']
    cs = [j for i in range(len(c)) for j in range(len(c[i])) if c[i][j] == 'O']
    return (min(rs), min(cs))
remaining = ['RIGHT']*4 + ['UP']*23 + ['LEFT']*18 + ['DOWN']*10 + ['LEFT']*5 + ['DOWN']*13 + ['DOWN']*6
pos = player_pos()
print('start', pos)
done = False
for k, mv in enumerate(remaining):
    if pos != (35,34) + (0,0) and k == 0:
        pass
    res = action([mv])
    r = last_action_result
    if r.get('done') or r.get('level_completed') or r.get('game_over') or r.get('run_complete'):
        print('STOP at', k, mv, r)
        done = True
        break
    np_ = player_pos()
    dr, dc = {'UP':(-1,0),'DOWN':(1,0),'LEFT':(0,-1),'RIGHT':(0,1)}[mv]
    exp = (pos[0]+dr, pos[1]+dc)
    if np_ != exp:
        print('MISMATCH at', k, mv, 'expected', exp, 'got', np_)
        break
    pos = np_
print('end pos', pos, 'actions done', k+1, 'of', len(remaining), 'stopped:', done)
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
